card.name: The start of quarts, quads, quarks
card.fires_on: The short piece "qu" at the start of a word that continues as quarts, quads, quarks or quake. It is strongest after a number or a body-part cue.

card.plain: It fires on the opening letters "qu" of words like quarts and quads, before the rest of the word is written.
